# Subramani Rao
Official website: https://subramanirao.com/

Subramani Rao is an award-winning cybersecurity leader, author and international speaker specialising in cyber resilience, AI security, GRC, operational technology security, incident response, business impact analysis and executive cybersecurity strategy.
